# Turn a year of bank transactions into Schedule C lines.

> Free tool for freelancers, sole proprietors and gig workers: drop in your bank or card CSV and get income and expenses sorted into Schedule C lines, with estimated-tax payments, health insurance and equipment held out, a platform-fee check against your 1099 gross, and a CSV for your preparer.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
